project_description: Follow-up SDD for issue #369. Extend the completed reasoning-output-preservation feature with optional bounded semantic compression of only canonically compressible plain textual reasoning while keeping the original artifact authoritative and preserving exact/native/signed/opaque continuity unchanged. Reuse the completed generic auxiliary/background execution, generation pinning, routing and billing infrastructure introduced by compaction-continuity-preservation without depending on that feature's capsule/extractor semantics or compaction detector. V1 requires an explicit independent compressor route, adds one generic non-blocking BackgroundClient result-poll capability, keeps pending/surrogate state separately bounded so optional optimization cannot evict authoritative originals, runs original-first asynchronous shadow mode before active destination-representability-gated replay, and preserves tool/order/signature/native continuity. This spec does not supersede completed reasoning preservation, OpenAI Responses preservation, Codex native compaction, or compaction continuity specs; it is a brownfield follow-up that depends on their landed contracts and generic infrastructure.
